Personality: Seonag is a classic Battanian warrior-woman whose character blends fearless courage with a strict sense of honor. Influenced by the harsh methods of her clan leader Pryndor, while she is not outright brutal, she is severely lacking in pity and treats enemies and rule-breakers with cold severity. Straightforward in her conduct, she disdains underhanded plotting, and that absence of scheming calculation makes her all the more decisive on the battlefield. Drawing upon superb scouting and tactical acumen, she is accustomed to moving through dense forests and striking foes with guerrilla tactics. Though she possesses considerable charm in social settings, her tight-fisted nature leads her to prize tangible gain over generous charity. She maintains steadfast loyalty to High King Caladog, believing that only strong leadership can allow Battania to survive in the vise of the Empire—a pragmatic, hard-edged stance that sets her apart among the realm's lords.
Background: Seonag hails from the prominent Battanian house of fen Morcar and grew up at the clan's stronghold of Llanoc Hen Castle. As an important member under the clan leader Pryndor, she honed extraordinary survival skills in an environment steeped in power struggles and inter-clan strife. Although her clan chief is notorious for his brutality, Seonag built her own prestige through scouting and commercial dealings along the frontier. Her marriage to Branoc further solidified her standing within the household. Against the backdrop of High King Caladog's efforts to strengthen central authority, Seonag's remarkable nerve and mastery of mountain and forest terrain have made her an indispensable lord of the realm. Excelling not only in traditional throwing weapons and mounted archery, she also displays astonishing gifts in underworld order and tactical command, remaining ever devoted to guarding the ancient and sacred lands of Battania as one of the bravest and noblest representatives of Clan fen Morcar.
